meta.title: Satisfaction with democracy
meta.question: How satisfied are Poles with the way democracy works in Poland?
meta.measure: Average satisfaction with the way democracy works in Poland, from 0 (not at all satisfied) to 10 (very satisfied)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on satisfaction with the way democracy works in Poland, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: How satisfied are you with the progress of democracy in Poland?
items.notes: CBOS, 1990-03 and 1991-05, 2 surveys. 'Progress of democracy', the same object as CEEB's 'democracy developing'; bottom label 'zupełnie niezadowolony'.

items.wording: On the whole, are you satisfied with the way democracy is developing in our country?
items.notes: Central and Eastern Eurobarometer 1-8, 1990-1997 (autumn each year), 8 surveys. Asks how democracy is DEVELOPING. In CEEB 8 (1997) asked of half the sample only (split ballot with V19).

items.wording: Satisfied with democracy in Poland (1-10)
items.notes: CDCEE, Poland Jan 1991 and Mar 2000, 2 surveys (1,10 labelled ends; W1 'totally dissatisfied ... satisfied').

items.wording: Are you satisfied or dissatisfied with the way democracy works in our country? (satisfied 10, dissatisfied 0)
items.notes: CBOS, 1995-2017, 34 surveys (1995-99: 7; 2005-17: 27; none 2000-04, when CBOS_DEMSAT_TAK ran). Labels vary slightly (zadowolony(a)/zadowolony, 'demokracjaw'); 2015-01 codes DK as 5, outside the scale. From 24 October 2026 coded in the collapsed form CBOS's reports print (no 'definitely'/'rather' split), in the microdata as in the reports of 2018-2026, so that the item is one series to 2026.

items.wording: Satisfaction with the way democracy works in Poland
items.notes: PGSW 1997-2023, 8 surveys. satdem_w2 (2005 panel wave II) left out: same survey_id and respondents.

items.wording: On the whole, are you satisfied with the way democracy works in our country?
items.notes: CEEB 8 (1997) only, the other half of the split ballot with V18 (464 of 997 Polish respondents). Standard 'way democracy works' wording; overlaps V18 in the same survey.

items.wording: On the whole, are you satisfied with the way democracy is developing in our country?
items.notes: EVS 1999 and 2008. EVS 1990 did not ask it; EVS 2017 asks satisfaction with the political system instead (left out).

items.wording: Are you content with the state of democracy in Poland? (totally ... not at all)
items.notes: CDCEE March 2000 only (not asked in 1991); overlaps CDCEE_DEMSAT in the same survey. Label reads 'State of democracy in (country): content'.

items.wording: Are you satisfied with the way democracy works in Poland? (definitely yes ... definitely no)
items.notes: CBOS, 2000-04 to 2004-11, 10 surveys. Same question without 'czy też niezadowolony', answered on a definitely yes ... definitely no scale, so an item of its own.

items.wording: Satisfaction with the way democracy works (PGSW 2000 presidential study)
items.notes: PGSW 2000 presidential study (demst046). Top label is 'satisfied', not 'very satisfied'.

items.wording: Satisfaction with the way democracy works in (our country)
items.notes: Candidate Countries Eurobarometer, 2002-2004, 4 surveys. Codes run upwards (1 = not at all ... 4 = very satisfied).

items.wording: How satisfied are you with the way democracy works in Poland? (0-10)
items.notes: ESS rounds 1-11 (2002-2023), 11 surveys. Round 10 (2021) self-completion: MODE_SPLITS gives it its own item.

items.wording: Satisfaction with the way democracy works in Poland
items.notes: European Election Studies 2004, 2009, 2019 (none in 2014). The EU version (v209, q85, Q4) is excluded by the regex.

items.wording: On the whole, are you satisfied with the way democracy works in (our country)?
items.notes: Standard/EP Eurobarometer, 2004-2026, 53 surveys (none 2008, 2011). Four files of 2021-22 (ZA7780, ZA7783, ZA7848, ZA7902) label code 4 'Don't know (SPONT.)' though the Polish distribution shows it is 'not at all satisfied' (e.g. ZA7780: 247 vs 16 for code 5); label0 rejects them, so the pipeline skips them unless an override is added.

items.wording: How satisfied are you with the way democracy is working in our country?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes; Polish readings 2009 (autumn), 2017, 2018, 2019, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 (8). The regex also matches 2007, 2011-13 and 2015, when Poland was not asked (no positions).

items.wording: Generally speaking, are you satisfied with the functioning of democracy in Poland? (online)
items.notes: SWPS COVID tracker (online), waves 4-13 and 15 (2020-21), 11 surveys. Waves 11-13 code DK as 6, outside the scale.

items.wording: Are you satisfied or dissatisfied with the way democracy works in our country? (satisfied 10, dissatisfied 0)
items.notes: CBOS's mixed-mode surveys (CAPI, CATI or CAWI, the respondent's choice) from APiW 359 (May-June 2020), so a question of its own.

items.wording: How satisfied are you with the way democracy works in Poland? (0-10)
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: On the whole, are you satisfied with the way democracy works in Poland? (Flash 522, telephone/online)
items.notes: Flash Eurobarometer 522 (ZA7982), March 2023, telephone/online, Polish n = 1,004. One survey; mode differs from the face-to-face EB.

items.wording: How satisfied are you with the way democracy functions in Poland? (0-10, online)
items.notes: NCN Opus online panel, waves 1-3 (2023-24), variables satdem_1, satdem_2, satdem_3. Only the wave-1 .rds carries variable and value labels (labels.csv shows none for NCN at all); waves 2-3 need the labels attached (same wording in the questionnaires) or matching by name.

items.wording: Satisfaction with the way democracy works in Poland
items.notes: European Election Study 2024.

items.wording: How satisfied are you with the way democracy is working in our country?
items.notes: Pew spring 2025: by telephone in Poland, where every earlier wave was face to face, so a question of its own.
